name: @altopelago/aes
description: Reference implementations and development material for AES, Telex v1, and the Film v1 draft

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path implementations/rust/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --manifest-path implementations/rust/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.test:film: node --test test/film-conformance.test.js test/film-decoder.test.js test/film-decoder-conformance.test.js test/film-incremental.test.js && cargo test --locked --manifest-path implementations/rust/Cargo.toml --test film --test film_api --test film_conformance
scripts.check:fuzz:film: cargo +nightly fmt --check --manifest-path implementations/rust/fuzz/Cargo.toml && cargo +nightly fuzz check --fuzz-dir implementations/rust/fuzz film_decode
scripts.fuzz:film: npm run seed:fuzz:film && cargo +nightly fuzz run --fuzz-dir implementations/rust/fuzz film_decode implementations/rust/fuzz/corpus/film_decode -- -runs=100000 -max_len=4096
scripts.public:check: npm run precommit && npm test && npm run check:rust && npm run test:rust && npm run validate:cts-claims && npm run test:conformance:shared && npm run test:conformance:rust:shared
